title: AI-Driven Cybersecurity Spending Surge
summary: AI is expanding the cyber attack surface and driving a secular surge in enterprise cybersecurity budgets, benefiting platforms like Fortinet that combine custom silicon with AI-native threat detection.

title: AI Data Center Optical Interconnect Buildout
summary: NVIDIA's next-gen GPU platforms require 1.6T+ optical interconnects, creating a multi-billion-dollar TAM for companies like Credo and Marvell that design the connectivity silicon and cables sitting in the critical path of every hyperscaler's AI infrastructure buildout.

title: AI Power Bottleneck — Gas Turbines and Nuclear Booked Solid
summary: Hyperscaler AI capex of $700B in 2026 has created a power infrastructure bottleneck, with GE Vernova's gas turbine backlog sold out through 2030 at rising prices and Constellation Energy's 60 GW clean power fleet capturing premium hyperscaler PPAs.

title: Aluminum Supply Shock — Gulf Smelters Stranded by Hormuz Closure
summary: The Strait of Hormuz closure has stranded ~3.5 million tonnes of Gulf aluminum supply — the largest base metals shock since 2000 — positioning Alcoa as the prime North American beneficiary with earnings doubling and a hidden data center land monetization catalyst.

title: Middle East Aluminum Supply Shock
summary: Iranian strikes on EGA and Alba removed ~3 million tonnes of annual aluminum capacity, spiking LME prices to $3,571/tonne and creating windfall margins for geographically insulated US producers Alcoa and Century Aluminum.

title: China Reopens Boeing Order Book — LEAP Engine Supply Chain Squeeze
summary: China's 200-jet Boeing order tightens the LEAP engine supply chain at peak utilization, creating operating leverage for GE Aerospace (50% CFM owner) and Howmet Aerospace (2x content per MAX) that the market missed while selling Boeing on a smaller-than-expected headline number.

title: Data Center Copper Demand Supercycle
summary: AI data centers consume 5-10x more copper per megawatt than traditional facilities, and the convergence of data center buildout, EV adoption, and grid electrification is creating a structural copper deficit that benefits the world's largest producer, Freeport-McMoRan.

title: Memory Supercycle — Most Severe DRAM Shortage in 15 Years
summary: Goldman Sachs forecasts the most severe DRAM shortage in 15 years (4.9% supply deficit) as HBM consumes 23% of wafers, driving Micron to 81% gross margins and positioning both Micron and Sandisk for a multi-year capacity-constrained pricing regime unlike any previous memory cycle.

title: HBM Memory Sold Out Through 2026 — Pricing Power Returns to DRAM
summary: All three HBM producers are sold out through 2026 with shortages extending to 2027+, while Microsoft's $190B capex raise and $700B+ hyperscaler buildout create structural demand that the memory oligopoly cannot satisfy — giving Micron unprecedented pricing power at just 7.9x forward P/E.

title: Iran Ammonia Supply Shock
summary: The Iran conflict and Hormuz closure have removed ~30% of global ammonia exports and ~49% of urea exports from the market, spiking nitrogen fertilizer prices 35%+ and creating a windfall for Nutrien's low-cost North American nitrogen operations.

title: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge — $50 Copay Unlocks ~60M Seniors July 1
summary: CMS's Medicare GLP-1 Bridge goes live July 1 with a $50/month copay for ~53M Part D beneficiaries, creating a step-function volume catalyst for Eli Lilly (Foundayo + Zepbound) and Novo Nordisk (Wegovy) that the sell-side has not yet modeled into Q3 estimates.

title: Rare Earth Magnet Supply Crisis — DoD-Anchored US Capacity Comes Online
summary: China's rare earth export controls have created persistent supply shortages, and MP Materials' DoD-anchored Independence magnet facility is the first Western mine-to-magnet operation to come online, with a 10-year off-take agreement and a path to 10,000 MT US capacity by 2028.

title: Silver Structural Deficit — Sixth Consecutive Year, Largest on Record
summary: Silver's sixth consecutive annual deficit (215 million ounces, the largest on record) has depleted above-ground stocks by 762M ounces since 2021, creating asymmetric price sensitivity to investment inflows and positioning primary silver producers WPM, PAAS, and AG for operating leverage at $70-100/oz pricing.

title: US Ethane Crackers Capture Middle East Polymer Outage
summary: The Hormuz blockade has disrupted ~50% of global polyethylene supply, spiking US PE prices from $0.30/lb to $0.60-0.70/lb and creating windfall margins for ethane-advantaged US crackers LyondellBasell, Dow, and Westlake running at 90%+ utilization.

title: US LNG Captures Multi-Year Qatari Supply Outage
summary: Qatar's LNG export complex (~20% of global supply) remains offline as the Strait of Hormuz crisis drives a structural reshoring of Asian LNG procurement toward US Gulf Coast exporters, with Cheniere signing multi-decade contracts and EQT benefiting from a permanent Henry Hub demand floor.
